description: Classifying land use within 80,000 mining sites on a global scale is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yu-Tong Cheng et al. The green energy transition has intensified global demand for critical minerals, driving the expansion of mining activities with significant environmental consequences. Coverage: global; published in 2026. Formats: Image, ZIP. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
